body:
Addressed in e6f730ad1: `broadcastResetToAllInstances` now wraps each sibling's `postStateToWebview()` in a try/catch. A sibling's state generation can throw mid-reset (e.g. through customModesManager's settings-file access); the failure is logged and the reset continues to the remaining instances instead of aborting the broadcast. Their buffers were already cleared before the post, so no instance is left half-reset. Regression test: three live instances where one sibling's post rejects during resetState() — the later sibling's buffer is still cleared and the caller logs the failure.

Validation: tsc --noEmit exit 0; 11 suites 611/611 on the merged tree (parallelMode, webviewMessageHandler, api-set-configuration, ClineProvider, sticky-profile, sticky-mode, importExport, switchModeTool, Task, ClineProvider.delegation, nested-delegation-resume); eslint --max-warnings=0 exit 0 on the touched files; no suppression count changes. Pushed with the main-first merge 9bf83e322.
